setupNotes: assignee.type: creator on every action is a training placeholder so the draft can be trialled without inventing IDs. Intended owners: Purchasing for cotacao_1/2/3, selecionar_proposta and encomendar; department managers for decidir; Finance for confirmar_cabimento. Design these groups with provia-organization-rollout before publication.
cotacao_1, cotacao_2 and cotacao_3 each need a form created and linked in Provia after import; see forms.md for the shared field specification (one form used three times, once per supplier slot).
Country (Angola), currency (AOA) and language (English) are provisional defaults — none was stated in the request; confirm before packaging.
Due dates and the 3-workday quotation deadline are illustrative, not an approved service level.

decisions.question: No source SOP or purchasing policy document was supplied for this workflow. The actions, thresholds and due dates in workflow.yaml are illustrative, built directly from the request, not an approved procedure.

The request asked to map three supplier-quotation Form Fill responses into the same incident amount field. Provia does not allow mapping any value from a multi-response Form Fill into incident metadata, and mapping three single-response actions onto one shared field would let each submission silently overwrite the previous one, losing two of the three quotations.
decisions.resolution: Each quotation gets its own case field (quote_1_amount, quote_2_amount, quote_3_amount) from its own single-response Form Fill action. A new Standard action, selecionar_proposta, is where a person compares the three and manually sets purchase_amount (and selected_supplier) once, with a mandatory comment. See forms.md for the full explanation and a documented alternative.

decisions.question: Should suppliers submit their own quotation through an external form link, instead of a Purchasing team member entering it on the supplier's behalf? This needs the respondent-access model confirmed in a connected Provia organization before it can be designed.
What happens if a supplier does not respond within the 3-workday due date on a quotation action: proceed with two quotations, extend the deadline, or require a documented sole-source justification?
